paragraphs: The Nehardeans, Nehardea's amoraim: Rav Ḥama (see his entry). 'The Nehardeans say,' Mo'ed Katan 19b, 27b; HaMafkid 36b. Shemuel was in Nehardea; 'and if from Babylonia,' it is he (see his entry). The Nehardeans say in Rava's name, Shevuot 7a.
